_help: Which model, effort and limits each task gets, per agent being called. Read on every call, so edits apply at once. A 'model' passed in the tool call wins over this table. agy ids: run `agy models`. Claude: haiku | sonnet | opus | fable or a full model id. Limits: timeoutS (both agents), maxTurns and budgetUsd (Claude only; agy has no such flags).

tasks.quick: Short questions, lookups, yes/no, small rewrites.
tasks.code: Write or change code, fix a bug, run a refactor.
tasks.review: Review code, a diff or a plan; find bugs or risks.
tasks.research: Read and summarise files, docs or a codebase; compare options.
tasks.deep: Hard design or debugging problems that need long careful reasoning.

stopRule: Stop as soon as the task is done: give the answer and finish. Do not keep exploring, re-checking or polishing once you have enough. If you cannot finish within the limits, say what is left and stop.
